q: Under which Article of the Constitution are supplementary, additional and excess grants made by Parliament?
Article 115(1)(a) provides for a supplementary grant when the amount authorised for the current year is found to be ______.
Article 115(1)(b) covers a demand when, during the year, need arises for expenditure upon some ______ not contemplated in the annual financial statement.
Which procedure applies to a statement of supplementary demands under Article 115(2)?

options.D: Same procedure as the annual financial statement (Articles 112 to 114)

q: Supplementary grants relate to the ______ financial year.
Excess grants relate to expenditure already incurred during a ______ year.
Before excess demands are presented to Parliament, they must first be examined by the ______.
The Public Accounts Committee examines excess demands on the basis of the report of the ______ on the Appropriation Accounts.
Supplementary Demands for Grants (Railways) are presented to Parliament by the ______.
A supplementary grant becomes available for withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund only after ______.
A token supplementary grant is sought when expenditure on a new service can be met by ______ but parliamentary authority is still required.
A cash supplementary grant involves ______.

options.D: actual additional cash outgo from the Consolidated Fund

q: Re-appropriation means transfer of funds between sub-heads ______ the same grant.
Re-appropriation cannot ______.

options.B: increase the total of the grant
options.D: be sanctioned by a competent authority

q: Expenditure on a new service requires ______ even if savings exist elsewhere in the grant.
Demands for excess grants are accompanied by ______ explaining the reasons for the excess.
Parliament's approval of an excess grant is a ______ of expenditure already incurred.
Supplementary demands relating to charged expenditure are ______.
The Appropriation Accounts of Railways show, for each grant, ______.
Unspent balances of a supplementary grant ______ at the end of the financial year.
Supplementary Demands for Grants (Railways) form part of the ______ presented to Parliament.
If savings are available within a grant to meet an unforeseen need, the proper course is ______ rather than a cash supplementary.
A technical supplementary grant is sought when a large re-appropriation between sections requires ______ though no fresh cash is needed.
Article 115 applies to Railway expenditure because Railway finances form part of the ______.
Excess over a voted grant and excess over a charged appropriation ______ require parliamentary regularization.
Supplementary demands ______ during a financial year.

options.A: must be presented only in March
options.B: may be presented in more than one batch

q: Like the annual financial statement, the statement of supplementary demands is laid before ______.
Voting on supplementary demands for grants takes place in the ______.
A cut motion ______ on a supplementary demand for grant.

options.C: can be moved only by the PAC
options.D: can be moved only on charged items

q: Supplementary demands for Railways are prepared by the Railway Board through the office of the ______.
The concept of new instrument of service is closely related to ______.
Expenditure incurred in excess of the authorised grant without prior authority is described as ______.
Which committee's scrutiny gives Parliament assurance before excess grants are voted?
Under Article 114, no money can be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund except under ______.
A supplementary grant is always linked to the ______ to which it relates.
Token supplementary grants are sought for a ______ sum.
The essential difference between supplementary and excess grants is one of ______.

options.A: timing - supplementary during the year, excess after it

q: In Railways, re-appropriation within delegated powers may be sanctioned by ______.

options.B: competent railway authorities such as the General Manager

q: Diversion of funds from a charged appropriation to a voted grant by re-appropriation is ______.
Excess demands are presented to the Lok Sabha after the ______ has reported on the Appropriation Accounts.
The constitutional basis for regularizing excess expenditure is Article ______.
A supplementary demand is necessary even when the total grant is adequate if the expenditure is on a ______.

options.B: new service not contemplated in the budget

q: In Railway accounts, excess under a grant is found by comparing actual expenditure with ______.

options.C: the sums authorised by the Appropriation Act

q: Which of the following is NOT a valid ground for seeking a supplementary grant?

options.D: A desire to build up savings

q: The Public Accounts Committee scrutinises excess grants to satisfy itself that ______.

options.A: the excess was unavoidable and properly explained
options.B: the policy behind spending was wise

q: Supplementary Demands for Grants are voted as ______.

options.B: separate demands like the main demands

q: After the Appropriation Bill for supplementary demands is passed, the expenditure is met from the ______.
The Contingency Fund of India is meant for ______ pending parliamentary authorization.
Advances taken from the Contingency Fund of India are later recouped through ______.
An excess grant, once voted by Parliament, ______ the overspending shown in the Appropriation Accounts.
In Railways, re-appropriation between voted sections beyond delegated powers requires the sanction of ______.

options.C: the Railway Board / Ministry of Finance

q: Supplementary Demands for Grants (Railways) are presented by the Railway Minister under the convention dating from ______.
The term additional grant in Article 115 covers expenditure on ______.

options.A: new services not contemplated in the budget

q: Supplementary expenditure classified as charged is ______.
Excess grants are generally passed by the Lok Sabha ______.

options.C: as a matter of course on the PAC's recommendation

q: A new service in Railway finance typically means ______.

options.D: expenditure of a new character not contemplated in the budget

q: Re-appropriation orders in Railways must be issued ______.

options.A: before the close of the financial year

q: If a Railway administration spends beyond the grant, the excess is first disclosed in the ______.
The authority to regularize excess expenditure vests in ______.
Token supplementary demands are presented mainly to obtain ______.

options.D: parliamentary authority for a new service
